findings.evidence: `rg` hit: line 85 `change (Grp.homMk'' (A := Grp.mk A.toOver) (B := Grp.mk B.toOver) ...).hom.hom = f`; Mathlib line `CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Grp.lean:147` defines `Grp.homMk''`, and line 153 marks the generated projection lemma as simp, so this proof is explicitly crossing wrapper internals.
findings.fix: Replace the `change` with a direct public simplification/projection lemma if available, or add a short comment explaining the necessary wrapper defeq and keep the proof isolated behind this lemma.
findings.issue: `Hom.toOverHom_mk'` uses `change` to expose `(Grp.homMk'' ...).hom.hom = f` through the induced-category/CommGrp/Grp wrappers without documenting why this definitional equality step is unavoidable.

summary: One proof still relies on an undocumented `change` through nested category wrappers, which violates the proof-quality rubric and makes the public constructor API fragile under representation changes.
